specs.data_output: Dual fisheye RGB image, fingertip 3D force tactile (optional), gripper open/close distance, IMU data, spatial localization trajectory

original_text_zh: Astra UMI 原生同构·精细操作 产品卖点：多模态感知，解锁精细操作数据。全面采集视觉、触觉、惯性、开合距离及运动轨迹，为复杂操作任务提供数据支撑。原生同构设计，数据即采即用：Gripper与机器人本体同构设计，数据格式天然兼容，最大程度缩小数据采集与真机之间的数据Gap。双鱼眼全覆盖，操作无死角：双鱼眼布局消除相机盲区，关键操作细节完整留存，确保数据完整度。指尖灵活切换，触觉数据需选配：指尖触觉与非触觉灵活切换，兼顾精度与刚度。基本参数：尺寸250×165×179mm，重量698g。核心参数：相机分辨率1920×1432，帧率30FPS，FOV 185°(H)×139°(V)，通信 有线通信，IMU采样频率≥200Hz，IMU 6轴。复合参数：最大开合距离116mm，夹持力≥2kg。输出数据格式：双鱼眼RGB图像、指尖三维力触觉（选配）、夹爪开合距离、IMU数据、空间定位轨迹。

subcategory: dry single-plate electromagnetic friction brake, spline-driven self-adjusting-gap design
description: MSB Series is STEKI's dry single-plate electromagnetic friction brake with a spline-driven, self-adjusting-gap design, spanning eight frame sizes (MSB1.2 to MSB100) with static holding torque from 12 to 1000 Nm. Per the maker's stated features it has an automatic gap-adjustment device (so no gap-adjustment shims are needed at assembly), a bearing-supported friction surface for easy assembly, no restriction on mounting orientation (vertical, horizontal, or in between), fast response with short torque build-up/release time and precise action, high heat-dissipation capacity for good durability, and non-asbestos friction material.
original_text_zh:
MSB型（乾式單板）電磁式制動器 DRY SINGLE-PLATE MAGNETIC BRAKE
型號 MODEL / 靜摩擦特矩 Static Friction Torque[kgm(Nm)] / 電壓 Voltage[DC-V] / 刀率 Power(W) at 20°C / 重量 Weight(kg) / 最高轉速 Maximum speed(rpm)
(特質 features, from companion page): 1.採用滑動摩擦結構，具自動調整間隙餘量 2.釋放間隙能力大，良好的耐久性 3.離合器磨擦面使用軸承支撐，裝配容易 4.磨擦片薄，且裝配不需使用軸向不假想配合，要自動水平方向上都可以安裝 5.規格多樣化，扭力銜接範圍廣，12-1000Nm可選 6.採用非石棉磨擦材質
review_reason: Category 'Gearbox/Transmission' remains a judgment call (no dedicated clutch/brake category exists in the fixed list). This is a brake (holding/stopping device), not a clutch, distinguishing it functionally from the other STEKI entries in this batch. The shared features-list text on _DSC2547.JPG has now been re-read at high zoom and is fully legible; the subcategory/description_en have been corrected accordingly (earlier best-effort translation had misread 采用滑動摩擦結構 as a 'sliding-friction structure' and 釋放間隙能力大 as 'gap-release capacity'; the correct text reads 花鍵驅動的結構 (spline-driven structure) and 熱放散能力大 (large heat-dissipation capacity)). All numeric spec-table values (static/dynamic friction torque, power, weight, max speed) have been re-verified against zoomed crops of the source photo and confirmed accurate. Verified across both spec-table pages (_DSC2548.JPG, _DSC2549.JPG). Detailed per-model shaft-bore and radial dimension tables were intentionally not transcribed into specs, since they are pure mechanical reference dimensions rather than performance specs. Following a follow-up request, the mechanical dimension tables were re-examined: this series' source tables explicitly label the bore as "Aperture d(H7)" (Chinese: kongjing) and the keyway as "Keyway b(E9)xt" (Chinese: jiancao), and the widest envelope diameter (diaA) was matched from the drawing, giving high confidence for outer_diameter, bore_diameter, and keyway across both spec-table pages (_DSC2548.JPG, _DSC2549.JPG). Other lettered rows (registers, bolt-hole counts/angles) were left untranscribed rather than guessed.
page_note: Consolidated from _DSC2547.JPG (shared features/mounting-example page for MSB/MSC-T) and _DSC2549.JPG (spec table continuation for larger frame sizes)

subcategory: Permanent-magnet-actuated fail-safe brake (spring/magnet engaged, released by power-off... note: engages when de-energized per non-excited design description on page)
description: A permanent-magnet brake from STEKI that uses permanent-magnet attraction (rather than a spring) to hold the brake plates engaged, giving stable braking torque, low noise, and long service life; available with either an internally-mounted or externally-mounted rotor arrangement, offered in two mounting-hole patterns (-11 and -12) across eleven frame sizes.

specs.max_speed_rpm: 10000 rpm for SMB03-SMB11; 8000 rpm for SMB14 and SMB16
specs.mounting_variants: Two mounting-hole-pattern options per size, designated -11 and -12; verified against both spec-table dimension pages (_DSC2578.JPG, _DSC2579.JPG). Contrary to the earlier assumption, the -11 and -12 flanges use the SAME bolt-circle diameters (G1/G2), hole patterns (s/u) and thread sizes (Y1/Y2) at every frame size, with one confirmed exception: SMB14's G1 bolt-circle diameter is 78mm on the -11 flange but 83mm on the -12 flange (G2=97mm on both). Each flange has two concentric bolt patterns, G1 (PCD1, holes at angle spacing 's', thread 'Y1') and G2 (PCD2, holes at angle spacing 'u', thread 'Y2'); SMB03 only has the G1/s/Y1 pattern (G2/u/Y2 = n/a).

specs.max_speed_rpm: 10000 rpm for SMB03-SMB11; 8000 rpm for SMB14 and SMB16

subcategory: Autonomous wheeled mobile robot chassis/base for humanoid robots
description: IB2S is STEP's wheeled mobile robot chassis platform intended as the base for humanoid robots, featuring five drive modes (normal, lateral, diagonal, crab/oblique, and parking), a 150kg upper-body payload capacity, 3D LiDAR-based SLAM navigation with 360-degree obstacle avoidance, and hot-swappable dual battery packs for continuous 24/7 operation.

specs.navigation: 3D SLAM with diagonally-mounted 3D LiDAR; ultrasonic sensors (8 units, front/rear/left/right - standard); depth camera (optional)
specs.charging: Automatic charging dock / quick battery swap

original_text_zh: IB2S 轮式机器人底盘。产品参数：外形尺寸L*W*H(mm) 689*560*388；整机自重(kg) 85；最大驻重(kg) 150；回转直径(mm) 780；离地间隙(mm) 40。运动性能：移动方式 全向移动；最大移动速度(m/s) 1.5；爬坡能力 10°；越障高度(mm) 30；过坎深度(mm) 30。多种模式：自驻模式、横移模式、斜移模式、蟹行模式、驻车模式。热插拔双电池结构，支持7*24小时连续作业；双3D激光雷达达全方位360°，定位精度±10mm；最大负载达150KG，可搭载不同规格的上身结构；四转四驱结构，全向底盘小空间同及多种复杂环境。感知与导航：3D SLAM；激光雷达(对角安装)；超声波(选配)；深度相机(选配)；定位精度±20mm；停止角度精度±1°。能源系统：48V/25Ah*2三元锂电池；自动充电/快速换电。交互与扩展：开放式接口 标配。

subcategory: 22-DOF anthropomorphic robotic hand with tactile fingertip sensing
description: A 1:1 human-hand-scale anthropomorphic robotic hand with 22 active degrees of freedom driven by 22 self-developed actuator modules, and multi-axis tactile sensors on the fingertips for force feedback. Rated for over 1,000,000 grasp cycles, with back-drivable joints and a force-sensor-based self-protection mechanism for safe interaction. Brochure cover for the Sphera 'Wave SE' anthropomorphic robotic hand, showing a five-fingered end-effector with segmented fingers and rounded fingertip pads. The tagline translates roughly to 'multi-dimensional perception, within tactile reach,' implying integrated tactile/force sensing at the fingertips, but no technical specifications are printed on this page.

original_text_zh:
仿生灵巧：1:1人手大小和构型，手部模型采用黄金比例设计（约0.618），接近真实人手尺寸与形态。22个主动自由度，支持丰富、自然的手部动作。丰富触觉：2mm空间分辨率，50mN力感知灵敏度，30fps触觉感知帧率。稳定可靠：超过100万次抓取循环的使用寿命，内置力传感器与算法赋能的自保护机制，关节可反驱，提升交互安全性。硬件：重量1.3kg，尺寸208mm x 90mm x 50mm，主动自由度22，传动机构22个自研动力模组，四指侧摆范围±20°，最小抓握直径10mm，有效载荷24kg，抓握力90N，指尖力12N，运行速度2Hz，工作电压18-28V，静态电流0.75A@20V，工作温度范围0°C to 45°C，指尖位置重复精度±1mm，标称寿命超过1,000,000次循环。触觉传感器：触觉分辨率60*60，力灵敏度0.05N，力感知范围0-30N，最大载荷50N，感知维度六维力:Fx,Fy,Fz,Mx,My,Mz，空间分辨率2mm，感知频率30fps，延迟20ms。软件：上位机软件Sharpa Pilot，开发工具Sharpa Wave SDK，通信频率500Hz，通信接口1000BASE-T Ethernet。

product_name: HarmoCore (轻量化谐波关节 / Lightweight Harmonic Actuator)
subcategory: Lightweight integrated harmonic-drive joint actuator with flexible mounting
description: HarmoCore is a lightweight, integrated harmonic-drive actuator joint combining a torque-sensing harmonic reducer, frameless motor, encoder, and onboard drive board within a compact shell/cover, designed to reduce joint weight and inertia while increasing achievable joint density on humanoid robots and robotic arms. Offered with multiple mounting options: single-sided, output-end double-sided, radial (circumferential), bilateral through-shaft, rod, and bottom-direct mounting.

specs.components: Harmonic reducer with integrated torque sensor, shell, frameless motor, encoder, drive board, cover
specs.mounting_options: Single-sided, double-sided (output end), radial, bilateral through-shaft, rod, bottom-direct

original_text_zh:
HarmoCore(TM) 轻量化谐波关节 极致轻巧 极强内核
灵活多样的安装形式:单侧固定、输出端双侧固定、周面径向固定、双侧贯穿固定、连杆固定、底部直连固定
谐波减速器集成扭矩传感器 壳体 无框电机 编码器 驱动板 后盖
为具身智能领域的用户定向研发,在充分减少关节体积和重量的基础上,自研发了全方位的安装接口,使用户可以在不增加机器人质量的基础上增加关节自由度,更高质量的动态响应性能,更高质量的负载力。
